IGPL's products are widely supplied to leading global and domestic manufacturers across dozens of backbone industries, including paints, coatings, plastics, flexible PVC, unsaturated polyester resins (UPR), automotive components, construction chemicals, and fragrances. Beyond dominating the Indian market, the company exports to international markets, exerting a strong global supply chain presence.
